    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">MAUI库推荐五：Maui.PDFView</span>

<h2 id="项目介绍">项目介绍</h2>
<p>用于在Android、iOS、MacOS和Windows平台显示PDF文件的库。</p>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>.NET MAUI</th>
<th>.NET 9</th>
<th>.NET 10</th>
</tr>
</thead>
</table>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Platform</th>
<th>Android</th>
<th>iOS</th>
<th>MacOS</th>
<th>Windows</th>
</tr>

<tbody>
<tr>
<td>支持</td>
<td>✅</td>
<td>✅</td>
<td>✅</td>
<td>✅</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h2 id="项目地址">项目地址</h2>
<p><a href="https://github.com/vitalii-vov/Maui.PDFView" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/vitalii-vov/Maui.PDFView</a></p>
<h2 id="使用方法">使用方法</h2>
<h4 id="1安装">1、安装</h4>
<p>通过Nuget进行安装：</p>
<pre><code>Install-Package Vitvov.Maui.PDFView
</code></pre>
<h4 id="2使用">2、使用</h4>
<p>在<code>MauiProgram</code>中添加<code>.UseMauiPdfView()</code>。</p>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">using Maui.PDFView;

public static class MauiProgram
{
    public static MauiApp CreateMauiApp()
    {
        var builder = MauiApp.CreateBuilder();
        builder
            .UseMauiApp&lt;App&gt;()
            .UseMauiPdfView();   // &lt;- Write this

        return builder.Build();
    }
}
</code></pre>
<p>在XMAL中添加<code>PdfView</code></p>
<pre><code>&lt;ContentPage
    x:Class="Example.Business.UI.Pages.MainPage"
    xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/dotnet/2021/maui"
    xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2009/xaml"
    xmlns:pdf="clr-namespace:Maui.PDFView;assembly=Maui.PDFView"&gt;

    &lt;!--
    IsHorizontal — display PDF horizontally
    Uri — path to the file on the device
    MaxZoom — max zoom level
    PageIndex — set the current page by index
    PageChangedCommand — event of changing the current page
    --&gt;
    &lt;pdf:PdfView
        IsHorizontal="{Binding IsHorizontal}"
        Uri="{Binding PdfSource}"
        MaxZoom="4"
        PageIndex="{Binding PageInex}"
        PageChangedCommand="{Binding PageChangedCommand}"&gt;
    &lt;/pdf:PdfView&gt;

&lt;/ContentPage&gt;
</code></pre>
<p>在<code>ViewModel</code>中添加<code>PsfSource</code></p>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">internal partial class MainPageViewModel : ObservableObject
{
    [ObservableProperty] private string? _pdfSource;

    [RelayCommand] private void ChangeUri()
    {
        try 
        {
            //  See the example project to understand how to work with paths.
            PdfSource = "/path/to/file.pdf";

            //  You can set the Uri property to null to clear the component.
            //PdfSource = null;
        }
        catch(Exception ex)
        {
             // handle exceptions
        }
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h4 id="3个性化">3、个性化</h4>
<p>PdfView 组件仅支持文件路径。这是因为在原生平台组件主要通过文件路径进行操作，若在组件内注解处理不同PDF数据源将极大增加代码复杂度。</p>
<p>因此，无论你的PDF数据以何种形式呈现——无论是字节数组、流、资源、还是URL——你都必须始终提供文件路径。</p>
<p>为简化与这些数据源的交互，该组件提供了实现PdfSource接口的辅助类：</p>
<ul>
<li>AssetPdfSource</li>
<li>ByteArrayPdfSource</li>
<li>FilePdfSource</li>
<li>HttpPdfSource</li>
</ul>
<p>使用PdfSource的例子：</p>
<pre><code>[RelayCommand] private async Task UploadUri()
{      
    var source = new HttpPdfSource("https://www.adobe.com/support/products/enterprise/knowledgecenter/media/c4611_sample_explain.pdf");
    PdfSource = await source.GetFilePathAsync();
}

[RelayCommand] private async Task UploadAsset()
{
    var source = new AssetPdfSource("Example.Resources.PDF.pdf2.pdf");
    PdfSource = await source.GetFilePathAsync();
}
</code></pre>
<p>你还可以创建自己的IPdfSource接口实现来满足你的特定需求。</p>
